spec.command: bash -c "source /etc/network_turbo && source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache && export HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1 && export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && cd /root/autodl-tmp/gen-depth-contamination && echo 'Waiting for v2 data files...' && while [ ! -f data_exp014_v2/cc_predictions.csv ]; do sleep 60; echo \"Still waiting... $(date)\"; done && echo 'v2 data ready, starting independent metrics' && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 python scripts/exp014_independent_metrics.py 2>&1 | tee results/exp014_v2/independent_metrics.log && echo 'Metrics done, starting analysis' && python scripts/exp014_independent_analysis.py 2>&1 | tee results/exp014_v2/independent_analysis.log"

experiment_data.hypothesis: 补算 6 个与 OBD 15D 特征完全独立的质量指标（GPT-2 Large PPL, MTLD, HD-D, 3/4-gram rep rate, MAUVE, Zipf coefficient），修正 v2 初版的循环论证问题。独立指标与 predicted depth 的 Spearman correlation 应显著（Bonferroni α=0.0083），验证 depth signal 的 ecological validity 不依赖 OBD 自身特征。
